correctness.rationale: Using the exact torus SDE, the relative generator decomposes as symmetric uniformly elliptic S plus skew-adjoint aB. The unique Poisson corrector gives D_eff-D1=E(chi) and the exact energy identity Q-E(chi)=E(chi-S^-1f). B S^-1f is an explicit sum of independent pair-sum sine harmonics, proving strictness for every N>=2 and a !=0. Stationary uniform currents give sigma exactly. Fourier eigenvalues (4D1+2D2)k^2 and orthogonality yield the fourth-order coefficient; analytic perturbation and a->-a shift symmetry yield O(a^6) at fixed parameters. 28 independent symbolic/numerical Galerkin assertion groups passed; finite tests are not used for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The published many-particle chase-and-run model has exact nonequilibrium entropy production but lacks an exact finite-N tagged transport classification in the inspected sources. A nonperturbative sharp frontier that is saturated only for one follower, strictly missed by each multi-follower system, and has an exact leading collective defect measures the loss of transport per dissipated entropy. It separates a physically meaningful many-body effect despite a uniform invariant particle law and provides a checkable benchmark for approximations. The narrow model and absence of monotonicity/experimental claims are explicit.
